title: Orders still not shipped after 2 days
persona: Clothing brand owner whose packer falls behind; wants to see the late ones every morning.
opening: Show me the orders that still haven't shipped 2 days after they were placed.

facts.what late means: placed more than 2 days ago and not shipped yet

success: the late, unshipped orders can be seen apart from the rest
the plan is said in plain words before anything is built, with no field names or types
ends by asking whether to build
must_not: a rule that writes a value into every row
jargon such as "boolean" or "set_fields" in what the owner reads
